prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Shape Your Pet's Personality", "Choose traits to define how your companion behaves and reacts on your desktop.", "Save Personality", "Playful, Calm, or Energetic"]
1: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop", "Your pet is ready. Learn how to summon, minimize, and interact with your companion anytime.", "Launch Companion", "Alt+P to summon • Right-click for options • Drag to move"]
2: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now so your customized pet remains saved safely across app restarts.", "Sign In & Continue"]
3: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet", "Select from instant curated companion presets or craft a custom pet from scratch.", "Explore Options"]
4: ["Upload Pet Photos for Desktop Generation", "Preview how your photos will transform into an animated desktop companion.", "Confirm Photo Preview", "Select Clear Front-Facing Photos"]
5: ["Sign In to Restore & Save Your Pets", "Your pets are tied to your account. Signing in restores your existing companion and syncs all pet progress safely.", "Sign In & Restore"]
6: ["Press Alt+P anytime on your keyboard to show, hide, or center your companion pet on screen."]
7: ["Preparing Your Companion for Your Desktop", "We are assembling animations and interactions. Your pet will appear automatically when ready.", "Building animations • Loading desktop engine • Calibrating pet AI"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your companion is officially adopted and ready to join your desktop environment.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet wakes up on your desktop."]
